title: Cloud save fix
fixes: Fixed the game freezing on 0.56.0 right after the welcome-back card closed (nothing could be clicked).
The welcome-back catch-up is faster when your PC holds thousands of Pokémon.

title: Cloud save
notes: Cloud save: your save now lives on your Discord account. Log in on any device (your PC, a Mac, the browser) and it’s your game, right where you left it. No more Export and Import to move it.

Two saves? If you’ve been playing on two devices (for example a PC and the browser), the first time you log in Tallgrass shows both side by side, with their Pokédex, Pokémon, money, badges and playtime, and you pick the one to keep playing. The other one is kept as a backup on your account. When one of them is brand new, Tallgrass keeps the bigger one by itself and tells you.
Play here now brings your newest save over from the other device before the hunt goes on.
New install? Log in and Tallgrass offers to load the save on your account, or start fresh.
F11 makes the Classic window full screen. F11 or Esc puts it back where it was.
changes: A small cloud in the corner of the scene shows whether your save is on your account (saved, saving, offline, or two saves to pick from). Hover it for details, click it for Cloud save.

Settings → Help → Cloud save: save now, and play one of the older copies your account keeps (the last few, one a day for a week, and any save you set aside). The save you were playing is kept as a backup.
Pokémon you traded, Wonder Traded or sold since an older copy was saved stay with their new trainers when you load that copy.
Offline play works as before: your save goes to your account when Tallgrass is back online.
Your save’s backups on this device stay as they were. Export / Import in the browser is still there for a copy of your own.

title: One device at a time
notes: One device at a time: if your account is already playing on another device, Tallgrass shows “Playing on another device”. Press Play here to carry on where you are, and the other device pauses with the same card until you press Play here on it. When you come back to a device, its catch-up only counts the time nothing else was playing.
New moves: Stone Axe (Kleavor can learn it) leaves pointed stones that hurt every Pokémon that comes in on the other side. Blood Moon (Ursaluna, from the Move Tutor) can’t be used twice in a row.
changes: Raid invites only list friends who can raid (5 badges). A small line under the list says how many can’t raid yet.
The Shiny, Void and Prismatic odds on screen include a running odds event, for example “1 in 190 (2× event)”.
Battle Tower: a Pokémon that evolves is offered its new form’s moves, including the ones it learns at Lv 1 or below its evolution level (Swampert: Earthquake and Hammer Arm, Volcarona: Heat Wave).
Ruin abilities (Wo-Chien, Chien-Pao, Ting-Lu, Chi-Yu) say what they weaken when they come in.

Protosynthesis and Quark Drive work like in the main games: in harsh sunlight or Electric Terrain they raise the Pokémon’s highest stat (Speed by 50%, the others by 30%), say so in battle, and wear off when the sun or terrain ends. Not in raids.
